title: Missing required identifier
description: Required primary or foreign identifier must be present

title: Duplicate record identifier
description: Each record key must identify exactly one record within its dataset

title: Unresolved reference
description: Related procurement supplier or award key must exist in its parent dataset

title: Potential duplicate supplier
description: Normalized organization names matching across identifiers require human investigation

title: Unusable reported contract value
description: Missing nominal or nonnumeric values require reporting context and must not be treated automatically as incorrect expenditure

title: Invalid date or currency format
description: Dates must be valid YYYY-MM-DD with start before end and currency codes must follow the configured format
